# Supported repair and reformation of a sustaining relation / 仍受支持的修复与维持关系再形成

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`supported-renewal-recovery` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](supported-renewal-recovery.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Restoration is a law of every balanced flow: joint surplus over enough steps brings a condition's level up to any target. In the support-gated law a supported contribution route restores the sustaining activity as an instance, while two actual histories with the same later inputs recover or do not.
>
> 恢复是每个平衡流的定律：足够多步的共同盈余使条件水平升到任一目标。支持门控规律中，仍受支持的贡献路径恢复维持活动是其实例；后续输入相同的两段实际历史，一个恢复，一个不恢复。

## Laws / 规律

1. For every balanced flow on every web, restoration is a law: a step of joint surplus raises a condition's level by at least one, and where the formations give jointly more than they take at each step at which the level is not below where it started, m − level steps bring the level to at least m.<br>对每个依存网上的每个平衡流，恢复是一条定律：一步共同盈余使条件水平至少升一；在水平不低于起点的每一步，各形成共同给予多于取走时，m − 水平 步使水平回到至少 m。 (`Becoming.Flow.surplus_raises_at`, `Becoming.Flow.surplus_bounded_at`, `Becoming.Flow.restores_at`, `Becoming.Flow.restores`)
2. Every law of the support-gated family is such a flow on its static web, so its restoration of the sustaining need is an instance, with the statement of the family theorem: within the existing support-gated law, an initially supported contribution route with positive net contribution throughout a deficit-length window keeps its own support and restores the sustaining activity.<br>支持门控规律族的每个规律都是其静态网上的这样一个流，所以它恢复维持所需是实例，命题即规律族定理的命题：在既有支持门控规律中，起初仍受支持的贡献路径若在缺口步数内持续有正净贡献，便保持自身支持并恢复维持活动所需的条件。 (`Becoming.SupportGated.renewal`, `Becoming.SupportGated.surplus`, `Becoming.SupportGated.flow`, `Becoming.SupportGated.web`, `Becoming.SupportGated.balances`, `Becoming.SupportGated.surplus_step`, `Becoming.SupportGated.repair_restores`, `RenewalRecovery.supported_repair_step`, `RenewalRecovery.repair_window_progress`, `RenewalRecovery.repair_restores_sustaining_support`)
3. If both activities lack support, the reached level remains constant despite later nominal contributions.<br>若两项活动都失去支持，实际水平此后不变，即使后续输入表仍列有贡献。 (`RenewalRecovery.inactive_pair_absorbs`)
4. Two actual draw histories have the same initial level and later inputs but opposite recovery outcomes; the recovered history is neither all-time renewing nor permanently consuming, and its supported pulse is an instance of the law of restoration.<br>两个实际取用历史从同一初值出发、后续输入相同，却分别恢复与不恢复；恢复历史既非全程更新型，也非永久消耗型；其受支持的脉冲是恢复定律的实例。 (`RenewalRecovery.same_future_inputs`, `RenewalRecovery.two_actual_pulses`, `RenewalRecovery.supported_pulse_recovers`, `RenewalRecovery.unsupported_pulse_never_recovers`, `RenewalRecovery.recovered_history_neither_global_class`, `Becoming.SupportGated.pulse_restores`)

## Conditions / 条件

- One natural-number condition, two threshold-supported activities and the inherited recurrence. Contribution and drawing enter actual change only while the focal activity is supported; sustaining renewal is likewise support-gated.<br>一个自然数条件、两项按阈值获得支持的活动及既有更新递推。贡献与取用只在焦点活动受支持时实际进入变化，维持更新也只在维持活动受支持时发生。
- Finite recovery requires initial repair support and contrib > draw at each of the next needG − level T steps; the schedule and its source are supplied.<br>有限恢复结论要求初始修复支持，以及随后 needG − level T 步每步 contrib > draw；这一供给安排及其来源不由定理导出。
- Non-recovery is restricted to the same law with both activities unsupported, no third injection, threshold revision or condition substitution; pulse witnesses supply exact initial values, thresholds and inputs.<br>不恢复结论限于两项活动均未获支持、无第三条注入、无阈值修订或条件替代的同一规律；脉冲见证具体给定初值、阈值与输入。

## Does not show / 未表明

- Does not derive contribution sources, activity selection, physical laws, general recoverability, whole-Becoming relational constitution or ethical necessity; G0/J/E stay explicit.<br>未导出贡献来源、活动选择、物理规律、一般可恢复性、整个 Becoming 的关系构成或伦理必要性；G0/J/E 保持明示。
- Finite recovery does not guarantee later maintenance.<br>有限恢复不保证窗口以后维持。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** unsupported_pulse_never_recovers refutes guaranteed recovery from a later contribution schedule alone; recovered_history_neither_global_class retains the interruption rather than replacing dynamics with a global label.<br>unsupported_pulse_never_recovers 反驳仅凭后续贡献表就保证恢复；recovered_history_neither_global_class 保留实际中断，不把全历史标签当作全部变化过程。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/RenewalRecovery.lean)
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Earlier material repair, initiation obstructions and continuous recovery basins retain credit; the delta is the finite window, absorbing state and actual-history comparison in this inherited gated law.<br>旧材料修复、启动障碍及连续恢复域已有成果；新增量限于此既有门控规律中的有限窗口、吸收状态及实际历史比较。 [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/RELATIONAL-BECOMING-INTEGRATION.md)

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** Premise-free (zero-substantive-axiom) grounding is a separate open target; completed G0/J results keep their scope. 无实质公理奠基是另一开放目标；已完成的 G0/J 成果保持原范围。

### Correspondence / 对应

Sustaining, drawing and repair differentiate roles within one unfolding. The inherited Law.level supplies the repair-window start; per-step progress through repair_window_progress feeds the original sustaining-support test. A first-draw difference changes actual repair support; later nominal inputs are not actual supply. No empirical correspondence to a real system is established.<br>维持、取用与修复是同一展开中分化的作用。旧 Law.level 给出修复窗口起点；每步净增通过 repair_window_progress 接到原维持支持测试。仅第一次取用不同的两段历史改变实际修复支持，后续名义输入并不等于实际供给。没有真实系统的经验对应。
